name: Your Name
summary: Platform-minded engineer who turns fragile services into dependable ones. Owns latency, reliability, and cost, and leaves behind the practices a team keeps using.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
bullets: Cut checkout latency from 3.2s to 410ms by rebuilding the pricing path as a streaming service, lifting conversion 5 percent.
Drove p99 error rate from 1.4 percent to 0.2 percent by adding backpressure and idempotent retries to the ingest queue.
Reduced cloud spend 18 percent by right-sizing the batch fleet and autoscaling on real demand signals.
Mentored 4 engineers and introduced the review checklist the platform team later adopted org-wide.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Built the ETL pipeline that consolidated 6 data sources into one warehouse, cutting report turnaround from days to minutes.
Shipped the public REST API used by 30 partner integrations, with versioning and rate limiting from day one.
Owned on-call for the data platform and wrote the runbooks that cut mean time to recovery by 40 percent.

skills.Practices: Distributed systems, streaming pipelines, observability, on-call, code review
